guardrails._note: Hard limits on generated copy. These are reproduced verbatim into every context pack and every application brief.
never_claim: A degree, graduation, or credential that has not happened yet — the degree is in progress.
Years of professional experience that no entry under `experience` supports.
An ICPC or contest placement not written in `competition`.
Employment at, or affiliation with, any organization not listed under `experience`.
Metrics, user counts, revenue, or performance numbers not present in a project's `evidence` field.
always_do: Prefer a specific named project over a generic adjective.
Leave a fact out rather than approximate it.
Flag every fabrication risk instead of silently filling the gap — see the OPEN QUESTIONS instruction in the brief.
